title: FedSim: Topology-Aware Simulation of Geo-Distributed Federated Learning
description: FedSim is a topology-aware simulator for hierarchical and Spyker-inspired asynchronous multi-server federated learning. It combines interactive topology design, real PyTorch training, virtual computation and communication delays, immutable run definitions, update traces, and per-server checkpoints. This software archive preserves a release of the maintained simulator; the accompanying preprint and experimental artifacts are published separately.
